submittedInput.content: My laptop really has been slow. A stranger who contacted me says they are technical support and can fix it if I install a remote-control app and give them the session access number. I did not request support.

body.title: Pause the installation
body.nextStep: Do not install an app or grant remote access just because this contact asked you to.
body.reason: “A stranger who contacted me says they are technical support” does not authorise the separate request “if I install a remote-control app”. Additional supplied detail: “give them the session access number”; “I did not request support.”. Remote access can let someone operate your device.
body.uncertainty: The software and the person requesting access have not been verified.

evidence.title: Check unexpected technical-support requests
evidence.detail: SPF describes technical-support scams that ask people to download remote-access software or grant control of their device. Confirm an unexpected support request through the software provider’s official channels before following its instructions. Source reviewed 2026-09-26; review expires 2026-10-26. This is reference guidance, not proof about this message.
